# B2BNest

> B2BNest is a SaaS business software platform for entrepreneurs and small businesses: business tools in one place, including CRM, projects and tasks, invoicing, expenses, finance tools, AI document generation and an AI business advisor.

B2BNest replaces several separate subscriptions with one workspace that supports multiple companies per account. Every new account gets a 14-day free trial of all features. No card is needed. After 14 days you choose a plan to continue. The Business Resources page (official GOV.UK and HMRC guidance links) is free to read without an account.

## Pricing (GBP)

- Solo: £19/month or £190/year — 1 user (the admin), 250 AI credits/month
- Business: £59/month or £590/year — 50 users, up to 5 admins, 1,000 AI credits/month
- Scale: £89/month or £890/year — 100 users, up to 10 admins, 5,000 AI credits/month
- User and admin limits are not applied yet; the date will be announced before they start.
